pages.title: WOD — Mission 23
pages.text:

pages.text:

pages.title: Aquecimento
pages.text:
400 m Easy Run
2 ROUNDS
8 Alternating Spiderman Lunges + Reach
10 Air Squats
8 Scapular Push-Ups
5 Broad Jumps (reset between reps)
1–2 ROUNDS COM BARRA VAZIA
8 Deadlifts
8 Hang Muscle Cleans
8 Strict Press or Push Press
8 Hang Power Cleans
8 Push Jerks or Push Press

pages.title: Skill — Power Clean & Jerk
pages.text:
EVERY 1:00 (8 SETS)
2 Power Clean and Jerks
1 REP = 1 Power Clean + 1 Jerk
Start Moderate and Build to Moderate-Heavy
SCORE: Weight

pages.title: WOD — Crash Bandicoot
pages.text:
RUN & POWER CLEAN
FOR TIME
400 – 300 – 200 – 300 – 400 m RUN
APÓS CADA CORRIDA: 7 POWER CLEANS
TIME CAP: 25’
SCORE: Tempo total

pages.title: WOD — Run Crash, Run!
pages.text:
2 SETS DE 3 ROUNDS
200 m Run
20 Wall Balls
200 m Run
20 m KTB Walking Lunges (PSE 8)
100 m Run
10 m Sled Push (PSE 8)
REST: 1’ entre os sets
TIME CAP: 50’
SCORE: Tempo total

pages.title: WOD — Murphing Crash
pages.text:
FOR TIME
1.600 m Run
50 Strict Pull-Ups
100 Push-Ups
800 m Run
Após completar a primeira corrida, dividir as 50 Strict Pull-Ups e os 100 Push-Ups como preferirem.
TIME CAP: 36’
SCORE: Tempo total

pages.title: Strength / Skill — Pós-treino
pages.text:
STRENGTH / SKILL — POST WORKOUT
3–5 SETS
3–5 REPS
5 s RING HOLD + 3 s DESCENT
Saltar até a posição superior, sustentar por 5 segundos e descer em 3 segundos até o fundo do dip. Ao chegar embaixo, saltar e reiniciar.
REST: 1:00 ENTRE SETS
